messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Loading large dataframe for use in several apps
parts:
One website structure I am considering is downloading a large amount of data into
a dataframe and running several apps off that via analysing the dataframe in different 
manners. Working locally this seems to be theoretically possible

In another post, I have raised problems of downloading this data to the shiny server
but assuming that gets sorted, I am still looking at a v long time for all the data
to arrive which will be unacceptable to most web users

One option I have considered would be to initially download probably in global.R 
a smaller dataframe which I could use for an initial  plot / table display 
At the end of the global.R script I would reopen the connection and download the full data
and by the time the user had finished with the first page it would have arrived
However, it seems working locally that the whole script has to be completed before a web page
is spawned. 

Is there any way round this or other suggestions to solve my problem
cheers
